FN-BNK94QQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 265
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 265 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Youth
Services (DYS) by an estimated $3.2 million annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 and each
fiscal year thereafter, by requiring DYS to reimburse counties for the cost of detention of
children in county custody beyond 12 business days after the juvenile court orders transfer of
custody to DYS.
Page 1

FN-BNK94QQ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 265
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 265 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund could
increase the obligations of the Department of Youth Services (DYS) by an estimated $2.7
million in Fiscal Year 2025 and an estimated $3.2 million in Fiscal Year 2026 and annually each
fiscal year thereafter, by requiring DYS to reimburse counties for the cost of detention of
children in county custody beyond 16 business days after the juvenile court orders transfer of
custody to DYS for Fiscal Year 2025, and beyond 12 business days thereafter.
